texts.preamble: Lal Chandra Jain vs State Of U.P. And Another on 8 September, 2025 High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:157275 High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad Application U/S 528 Bnss No. - 33951 of 2025 Lal Chandra Jain .....Applicant(s) Versus State of U.P. and Another .....Opposite Party(s) Counsel for Applicant(s) : Chandra Prakash Pandey, Vinay Bhushan Upadhyay Counsel for Opposite Party(s) : G.A. Hon'Ble Vikas Budhwar, J. 1.
texts.arguments: Heard Sri Vinay Bhushan Upadhyay, learned counsel for the applicant as per the instructions submits that though the present application under Section 528 BNSS has been preferred by the applicant for quashing the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No. 1467A/2008 (State Vs Lal Chandra Jain) under Section 7/16 Prevention of Food Adulteration (PFA) Act, 1954, Police Station- Mahoba District- Mahoba, pending in the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Mahoba and summoning order dated 03.06.2008 passed by Chief Judicial Magistrate, as well as Non Bailable Warrant Order dated 02.02.2021 passed by Chief Judicial Magistrate, Mahoba and its consequential proceedings, however, he confines his relief to the extent that since non-bailable warrant has been issued post obtaining of bail on account of the fact that due to certain reasons beyond the control and comprehension the applicant could not participate and join the proceedings, thus a breathing time be accorded to the applicant to submit a recall application to recall the non-bailable warrant before the court below and till the disposal of the recall application, applicant be accorded protection. 2.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Heard Sri Vinay Bhushan Upadhyay, learned counsel for the applicant as per the instructions submits that though the present application under Section 528 BNSS has been preferred by the applicant for quashing the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No. 1467A/2008 (State Vs Lal Chandra Jain) under Section 7/16 Prevention of Food Adulteration (PFA) Act, 1954, Police Station- Mahoba District- Mahoba, pending in the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Mahoba and summoning order dated 03.06.2008 passed by Chief Judicial Magistrate, as well as Non Bailable Warrant Order dated 02.02.2021 passed by Chief Judicial Magistrate, Mahoba and its consequential proceedings, however, he confines his relief to the extent that since non-bailable warrant has been issued post obtaining of bail on account of the fact that due to certain reasons beyond the control and comprehension the applicant could not participate and join the proceedings, thus a breathing time be accorded to the applicant to submit a recall application to recall the non-bailable warrant before the court below and till the disposal of the recall application, applicant be accorded protection. 2.
